description: The widget and the knob's base declare `invalid` with the same block-bodied transform, and the base renames it with `alias` after it, so the `Field` directive binds `invalid` on the widget and nothing on the knob. Read by a pattern ending a declaration at its first line ending in `;`, both stopped inside the transform at `const on = booleanAttribute(value);`, read the same, and the input passed (measured).
